roles_en: Last prime minister of the Republic of Armenia
bio_am: Ծնած է Նոր Նախիջեւանի Մեծ Սալա գիւղը։ Անկախ Հայաստանի վերջին վարչապետը (1920), մահացած է Պէյրութ՝ 1969-ին։
bio_en: Simon Vratsian (Gruzinian) was born in Mets Sala near New Nakhichevan on the Don and studied at the New Nakhichevan diocesan school and, from 1900 to 1906, at the Gevorgian seminary, joining the ARF as a youth. He led the party in the Nalband region, represented it at the 1907 General Congress, and from 1911 edited Hairenik in America for about three years. In 1914 he attended the Karin congress, served in Tiflis and Yerevan, and in 1918 was a delegate to the Batum peace conference; he became the last prime minister of independent Armenia on 23 November 1920 and in 1921 chaired the Salvation Committee of the February uprising. A prolific historian and memoirist in exile, he died in Beirut in 1969.
